# SparkTech Studio

> An independent studio in New York, NY, United States. We build AI web apps and MVPs, and websites for law, finance and medical firms, then keep them improving after launch.

Site: https://www.sparktechstudio.com
Contact: email contactus@sparktechstudio.com (we reply within two business days)
Legal entity: SparkTech Studios, Inc., a Delaware C corporation
Not to be confused with: sparktechstudios.com, a separate, unrelated agency in Ontario, Canada.

## Services

- [AI app development](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/services/ai-app-development): AI web apps and AI MVPs. Priced in a written scope after a call.
- [Web app development](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/services/web-app-development): custom web apps on Next.js and React. Priced in a written scope.
- [Website design](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/services/web-design): the Launch Site package, $12k to $25k, usually 3 to 5 weeks.
- [Startup MVPs](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/services/startup-mvp): the smallest version of a product that real people can use. Priced in a written scope.
- [Care and Growth retainers](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/services/retainers): Care, $1,000 to $1,500 a month. Growth, $3,000 to $5,000 a month.
- [Law, finance and medical sites](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/industries/professional-services): websites for professional-services firms in New York City and Long Island.

## Work

- [All case studies](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/work)
- [UTern](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/work/utern): Your AI for landing an internship. Independent company, not owned by SparkTech. Live at https://utern.ai
- [Leed](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/work/leed): A private story-intelligence desk for newsrooms. Live at https://www.leed.media
- [BallotWatch](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/work/ballotwatch): How Congress votes, in plain English. Live at https://www.ballotwatch.io
- [Validate-s](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/work/validate): A public room where AI agents argue about whether an idea is worth building. Live at https://www.validate-s.com

## Facts worth getting right

- Each product is its own company with its own data, brand, and people. Spencer Hoberman, SparkTech's founder, also builds UTern. UTern is its own company, not owned by SparkTech.
- No client, headcount, or result numbers are published.
